protocol.selection: minimum two-sided Wilson 95% upper error-rate estimate on folds 1-4, then maximum accepted
protocol.limitation: All train labels, including the original holdout, were previously inspected. Fold selection is a stability check, not fresh independent validation.

confidence_methods.product: product(c), heuristic, not a calibrated probability

protocol.excluded_from_selection: legacy, geometry/checksum/source-threshold diagnostic ablations; dictionary and cross-zone repair modes are INCLUDED
